name: Weekly Brief
tagline: Your newsletters, ranked into one weekly brief.
summary: Weekly Brief reads your newsletters and delivers one AI-ranked digest to Readwise Reader, Matter, or Kindle. Read the 3 that matter, skip the rest.
description: Newsletter subscriptions fail the same way: 30 arrive, 3 deserve your time, and the good ones drown. Weekly Brief connects to your newsletter firehose and, once a week, ranks everything against what you actually care about. You get one brief with the must-reads on top and the rest triaged below, delivered to Readwise Reader, Matter, or Kindle instead of your inbox. It ranks, it does not summarize: you still read the originals, just only the ones worth it. Free for up to 10 newsletters.
positioningRule: It RANKS newsletters, it does not summarize them — never write 'summarizes'. Free tier only; never enter payment, always decline paid/featured upsells.
